nl: 会员等级管理（SFC 模式）：查询有等级名称、升级条件（下拉数据来自 /api/conditions 接口）；表格展示等级名称、升级条件、所需积分、状态；支持新增、编辑；「所需积分」列仅在有权限时可见，权限码 member:points:view；字段标签走 i18n；界面要求国际化。
nlEn: Member level management (SFC mode): query by level name and upgrade condition (the condition dropdown data comes from the /api/conditions endpoint); the table shows level name, upgrade condition, required points, and status; supports add and edit; the "required points" column is visible only with permission, code member:points:view; field labels use i18n; the UI requires i18n.
notes: sfc 模式：不携带 tableBtns/dialogs/operationColumn（会被丢），也不带 formLayout（sfc 生成器忽略它）。i18n → labelKey；apiParams 字段须 inQuery:true 才会 emit 进 query formItems；permissionValue 任意模式安全。
